lom:description.lom:string: Residents provide patient care that is compassionate, appropriate and effective for the treatment of health problems and the promotion of health.

lom:contribute.lom:entity: BEGIN:VCARD VERSION:3.0 FN:Lakeside Graduate Medical Education Consortium END:VCARD

References.Reference: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education. ACGME Common Program Requirements (Residency), section IV.B.1.b), Patient Care and Procedural Skills. https://www.acgme.org/

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: Patient care includes gathering essential information about the patient, making informed decisions about interventions, developing and carrying out management plans, and counseling patients and their families.

xhtml:ul.xhtml:li: PC1: Gathers essential and accurate information about the patient
PC2: Develops and achieves a comprehensive management plan
